prompt: Redraw this isometric city map as detailed pixel art in the style of a classic isometric city-builder game. Keep every building, road, pond, rock and tree in exactly the same position, size and shape; do not add or remove buildings. Warm sunlit palette, crisp 1-pixel outlines, no blur.
